description: Inverse of apply_recipe: walk a COMP's child network in TouchDesigner and serialize it back to a draft RecipeSchema JSON (nodes + non-default parameters + connections + cross-references). Validates against RecipeSchema before returning. When write_path is set, writes pretty JSON to that vault-relative path; otherwise returns the recipe in structuredContent. Read-only with respect to TD — no operators are created or modified.

detect_cross_refs.description: When true, rewrite str params whose value matches a sibling node's name to the bare sibling name (the apply_recipe convention).

id.description: Recipe id/slug. Also the default filename stem when write_path is set.

include_defaults.description: When true, keep every CONSTANT-mode parameter (verbose; useful for round-trip debugging).

overwrite.description: Refuse to clobber an existing file unless true.

root_path.description: COMP whose direct children are serialized into the recipe.

write_path.description: Optional vault-relative path to write the recipe JSON to (e.g. Recipes/myrec.json). When null, the JSON is returned in structuredContent only.

name: scaffold_recipe_from_network
title: Scaffold a recipe from an existing TD network
